crew.overview: Adventure awaits 12 year old Brendan who must fight Vikings and a serpent god to find a crystal and complete the legendary Book of Kells. In order to finish Brother Aiden's book, Brendan must overcome his deepest fears on a secret quest that will take him beyond the abbey walls and into the enchanted forest where dangerous mythical creatures hide. Will Brendan succeed in his quest?
crew.title: The Secret of Kells

details.biography: Sjef Scholte is a Dutch film producer. He founded the company Bridge Entertainment (now Just Entertainment) and is the founder and CEO of Mountain Road Entertainment.
details.name: Sjef Scholte
